title: 第17章 超神的张三第18章 柔媚的心意
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
眼下当务之急还是治疗柔媚手上的伤口，张三看了一眼门口说道：
“你稍等一下，我去拿点东西，马上回来。”
“嗯，好。”
柔媚乖巧的点了点，目送张三跑出房门。
“系统，你快来帮下我。”
不过张三在出门不远的拐角处就停了下来，确定四下无人后，就开始和脑内的系统对话。
“你能不能给我列出治疗那女孩的物品？”
治疗受伤的女孩自然需要药品和纱布，张三身上虽然没有，但他有系统提供的兑换商城。
他记得那个商城里的可兑换物品能称得上是琳琅满目、包罗万象，事实也确实如此。
【好的，主人，这就为您寻找“治疗轻度刀伤”的道具……商城物品清单检索完毕，请您挑选。】
在感知到张三这边的需求后，系统很快给他罗列了一批他能用得上的药物清单。
一瓶清水，一卷医用纱布、一瓶双氧水、一盒九品金疮药。
这些物品全都买下，总价也才100点，张三在用意念快速选中并确认兑换。
【物品正在生成，共消耗100点，您的点数余额为点。】
在系统完成播报后，没有几秒，这些物品在三道白光和一道微弱的蓝光中出现。
或许是因为张三一次性兑换了四件物品，发出的光亮也比他先前兑换单件物品时要强烈得的多，甚至有些刺眼。
当然张三没时间纠结这些小事，柔媚这边距离出发所剩下的时间不多了，张三直接抱着这些医疗物品，快速返回了柔媚的房间。
“嘿！小丫头！我借来了一些纱布和药，你先用着。”
张三快步跑到柔媚跟前，将这些治疗道具都放在了她的床铺上。
由于张三不想在任何人面前暴露自己身上系统的存在，所以他这边也只能谎称这些物品是借来的，而且他也做好了柔媚细究这些药品的来历，去敷衍对方的准备。

结果柔媚只是困惑的说道：
“三哥，刚刚你过来的那边是不是有什么的东西在发亮了？”
“啊？是吗？没有吧？”
张三吓了一跳，他当然知道柔媚在说什么。
他本以为自己和系统的任何互动，其他人是看不到的，比如那个奇异的系统面板，还有系统与他交流时的声音等等，他现在能明确这些是旁人看不到的。
结果系统在生成物品时的光亮居然能被柔媚这个普通女孩看到，那其他人应该也是一样的。
而这就说明他以后从系统商城兑换物品时，得更为小心的避开旁人耳目了。
“呃？那、那应该是我看错了。”
柔媚也没太追究这事，她更好奇张三拿出来摆床上的那些东西。
“这些是什么啊？”
“这是水。”
张三拿出床上那瓶清水，一把拧开瓶盖后，半跪在坐在床上的柔媚跟前说道：
“你把手伸出来，我给你洗下伤口。”
“额，好、好的。”
柔媚听话的伸出受伤的右手，她看着眼前正小心牵着自己的伤手的男孩有种受宠若惊的感觉，脸颊也是红扑扑的，对话时的心情再次紧张起来。
不过在张三将倾倒清水前，柔媚还是好奇的问道：
content_en:
The top priority now is to treat the wound on Roumei’s hand. Zhang San glanced at the door and said:
"Wait a moment, I'll go get something and I'll be back soon."
"Yeah, okay."
Roumei nodded obediently and watched Zhang San run out of the room.
"System, come and help me."
However, Zhang San stopped at the corner not far from the door. After making sure that no one was around, he started talking to the system in his brain.
"Can you give me a list of items to treat that girl?"
Treating the injured girl naturally requires medicine and gauze. Although Zhang San doesn't have any on his body, he has the exchange mall provided by the system.
He remembered that the redeemable items in that mall could be described as dazzling and all-encompassing, and that was indeed the case.
[Okay, Master, I’m going to look for props to “treat mild stab wounds” for you... The shopping mall item list has been retrieved, please make your selection. 】
After sensing Zhang San's needs, the system quickly gave him a list of drugs that he could use.
A bottle of water, a roll of medical gauze, a bottle of hydrogen peroxide, and a box of nine-grade gold sore medicine.
All these items were bought for a total price of only 100 points. Zhang San quickly selected and confirmed the exchange with his mind.
[Items are being generated, 100 points are consumed in total, and your point balance is 100 points. 】
After the system completed the announcement, within a few seconds, these items appeared in three white lights and a weak blue light.
Perhaps it was because Zhang San exchanged four items at once, and the light emitted was much stronger than when he exchanged a single item before, even a little dazzling.
Of course, Zhang San didn't have time to worry about these trivial matters. There was not much time left before Roumei's departure. Zhang San directly hugged these medical items and quickly returned to Roumei's room.
"Hey! Little girl! I borrowed some gauze and medicine. You can use it first."
Zhang San quickly ran to Roumei and placed all these healing tools on her bed.
Since Zhang San didn't want to expose the existence of his system in front of anyone, he could only lie and claim that these items were borrowed, and he was also prepared to carefully study the origin of these medicines to deal with the other party.
In the end, Roumei just said in confusion:
"Third brother, is there something shining over where you came just now?"
"Ah? Really? No?"
Zhang San was startled, of course he knew what Roumei was talking about.
He originally thought that any interaction between himself and the system would not be visible to others, such as the strange system panel, the sound of the system communicating with him, etc. Now he can clearly understand that these are invisible to others.
As a result, the system's light when generating items could actually be seen by Roumei, an ordinary girl, and it should be the same for others.
And this means that when he exchanges items from the system mall in the future, he will be more careful to avoid the eyes and ears of others.
"Huh? Then, I must have seen it wrong."
Roumei didn't pursue this matter too much. She was more curious about the things Zhang San took out and placed on the bed.
"What are these?"
"This is water."
Zhang San took out the bottle of water on the bed, unscrewed the cap, half-knelt in front of Roumei who was sitting on the bed and said:
"Put out your hand and I'll wash your wound."
"Uh, okay, okay."
Roumei obediently stretched out her injured right hand. She felt flattered when she saw the boy in front of her who was carefully holding her injured hand. Her cheeks were also flushed, and she became nervous again during the conversation.
However, before Zhang Sanjiang poured the water, Roumei still asked curiously:
